title: SARC044: A Phase II Trial of Bezuclastinib in Combination With Sunitinib in Patients With GIST

metadata.lead_sponsor: Sarcoma Alliance for Research through Collaboration

primary_outcomes.measure: To estimate the median progression free survival (mPFS)
primary_outcomes.timeFrame: From the time of first dose to the occurrence of disease progression (as accessed by mRECIST v1.1) or death due to any cause prior to documented disease progression, up to 2 years..
